opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be an exceptional independent researcher, based in a UK university or UK not‑for‑profit research organisation.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary cross‑disciplinary research scheme for established researchers to pursue curiosity‑driven research.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement projects with galleries, archives, libraries, museums or performing arts organisations.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: Travel, accommodation and visa costs covered.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers affiliated with UK or German research institutions.
opportunities.summary: Attendance at a research collaboration symposium on ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: Funding covers 80% of salary costs and indirect costs; award up to three years.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in humanities or social sciences based at a UK university or research organisation.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to pursue independent research leading to a publishable output.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK higher‑education institution or independent research organisation.
opportunities.summary: Support for skill and capacity development in quantitative methods, data science, digital humanities and languages.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigator in humanities/social sciences (postdoctoral or above) with international co‑applicants; collaboration across SHAPE and STEM disciplines required.
opportunities.summary: Projects on mobilities that integrate humanities/social sciences with any SHAPE or STEM discipline.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑career or mid‑career researchers in humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships hosted at DGAP in Berlin, addressing security, Indo‑European relations, technology, and strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs Funding

amount.raw: Up to £4,000 (higher amounts possible on justification).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding for additional needs such as equipment, caring costs, or support to prepare applications.
